findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "finance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sec_financials, treasury_yield_curve, get_fx_rates, get_live_fx_rates, check_stablecoin_peg, get_token_price, get_dex_price_candles, get_large_token_trades, get_large_solana_token_trades, check_solana_reward_token_yield, get_exchange_reserves, get_solana_token_price, validate_identifier, get_public_holidays, count_or_add_business_days, check_sanctions, rank_funding_carry, get_macro_snapshot, get_local_crypto_premiums, pre_trade_check, transfer_preflight, get_crypto_fear_greed_index, get_lending_yields, get_protocol_tvl, get_stablecoin_supply, get_dex_volume, get_protocol_fees, get_near_account · Private data: get_token_price, get_large_token_trades, get_large_solana_token_trades, check_solana_reward_token_yield, get_solana_token_price, compare_stablecoin_transfer_fees, transfer_preflight · Public sink: sec_company_lookup, sec_financials, get_exchange_reserves · Destructive: validate_identifier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sec_financials, treasury_yield_curve, get_fx_rates, get_live_fx_rates, check_stablecoin_peg, get_token_price, get_dex_price_candles, get_large_token_trades, get_large_solana_token_trades, check_solana_reward_token_yield, get_exchange_reserves, get_solana_token_price, validate_identifier, get_public_holidays, count_or_add_business_days, check_sanctions, rank_funding_carry, get_macro_snapshot, get_local_crypto_premiums, pre_trade_check, transfer_preflight, get_crypto_fear_greed_index, get_lending_yields, get_protocol_tvl, get_stablecoin_supply, get_dex_volume, get_protocol_fees, get_near_account · Private data: get_token_price, get_large_token_trades, get_large_solana_token_trades, check_solana_reward_token_yield, get_solana_token_price, compare_stablecoin_transfer_fees, transfer_preflight · Public sink: sec_company_lookup, sec_financials, get_exchange_reserves · Destructive: validate_identifier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
